caption: The drawing is composed of dark blue ink lines on a light brown background. In the center, there is a large, stylized bird with detailed tail feathers and wings, perched on a branch that extends from the right to the left. The bird has a round eye, a small beak, and flowing, decorative plumage. Above and to the left of the bird, there is a simple outline of a jug with a handle and a stopper, drawn with minimal detail. At the bottom of the image, partially cropped by the lower edge, there is the neck and upper portion of a jug with the text "WHITE'S UTICA" and the number "4" inscribed on it in blue ink. The lines are clean and deliberate, and the overall composition is balanced with the main focus on the bird and supporting elements of the jugs.
title: Stoneware Jug
